system.description: You cut one of the target's sensor systems (your choice). For WIL ÷ 5 action turns, the target loses that type of sensory input. The sensors that may be negated include vision, hearing, touch, proprioception, direction, radar, lidar, t-ray, electrical sense, radiation sense, and any other augmented sense. Any actions that rely on the impaired sense require a test with a minimum -30 modifier.
